title: Hypothalamus, Thalamus, Basal Ganglia and Cerebral Cortex
summary: Hypothalamus and thalamus functions; types of hypothalamus; basal ganglia; cerebral cortex and four lobes (frontal, parietal, occipital, temporal).
objectives: Identify four cerebral lobes and their functions.
revision: Thalamus = sensory relay; Hypothalamus = homeostasis; Basal ganglia = motor control/habits. Lobes: Frontal = executive, Parietal = somatosensory, Occipital = vision, Temporal = auditory/memory.
traps: Frontal lobe contains Broca's area (speech production).

notes.t: The basal ganglia are a group of subcortical nuclei involved in motor control, procedural learning, routine behaviours and habit formation.

r: Executive function, motor control, speech (Broca's area)

notes.t: UGC NET frequently tests lobe functions: occipital = vision, temporal = auditory, frontal = executive/motor, parietal = somatosensory.

mnemonics.title: FPO T
mnemonics.text: F — Frontal (executive/motor), P — Parietal (somatosensory), O — Occipital (vision), T — Temporal (auditory/memory)

diagrams.caption: Four cerebral lobes: frontal, parietal, occipital, temporal
